summary: Created and opened `desk:apps:temp`; it shows `C: 25` and `F: 77` after typing 25.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give {c: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'backspace'
when count(s.c) > 0
set s.c to slice(s.c, 1, count(s.c) - 1)
done
or when '0123456789-.' has k
set s.c to s.c & k
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s.c)
when is_number(s.c)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & (number(s.c) * 9 / 5 + 32))
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
done
